+## Twelve lenses
+
+### Aset
+
+SSSES (business case): security 93 · stability 93 · scalability 90 · efficiency 93 · succinctness 90
+
+Consistency is a figure that reads the same to the analyst and to the reader who never trained in finance, and the deck's headline return, NPV proxy plus one million, leaned on three letters a plain reader could not open. NPV first appears in the financial-reset line, unglossed, a slide before it returns as the live proxy. This round writes net present value beside it where the reader first meets it, drawn from the master's own formula. Founder, your return figure now speaks to every reader, not only the analyst. Investors, the number you weigh names itself. Future customers, the return is now legible to you from its first appearance, plainly.

+### Asar
+
+SSSES (business case): security 93 · stability 93 · scalability 90 · efficiency 93 · succinctness 90
+
+Synthesis is the whole case closing in one reading, and a case that turns on a return no plain reader can open has not closed. The deck's return, NPV proxy plus one million, is the figure an investor weighs first, yet NPV was spelled out nowhere a reader meets it. This round resolves it at its first shown appearance: net present value, the return in today's dollars, drawn from the master's formula. Founder, the case now closes for the reader without a finance degree. Investors, the headline return names itself where you first read it. Future customers, the meaning of the deck's return is whole from the financial slide onward, plainly.

+
+SSSES (business case): security 93 · stability 93 · scalability 90 · efficiency 93 · succinctness 90
+
+Strategy is judged by whether its return can be read by the people it must persuade, and this return, NPV proxy plus one million, spoke only to those who already knew what NPV meant. A reviewer without finance training met the deck's headline figure and could not weigh it. This round writes net present value where the term first appears, on the financial slide, drawn from the master's formula. Founder, the figure your whole case rests on now reads for every reviewer. Investors, you weigh a named return, not an acronym. Future customers, the discipline behind the number is legible to you, whatever your training, from where the deck names it.

+words: 111

+
+SSSES (business case): security 92 · stability 92 · scalability 90 · efficiency 93 · succinctness 90
+
+Coherence is one word meaning the same to everyone at the table, and NPV split the readers into those who knew it and those who guessed. Peace on the financial page cannot rest on a return only the trained can open. This round settles it once, where the reader first meets it: net present value, the return in today's dollars. Founder, this is candour, the number named in plain words. Investors, every reader now holds one meaning of the headline return. Future customers, the deck no longer asks you to already know finance to read what it earns. The return that carries the whole case speaks to all of you, plainly.
